# deps/7-Zip-zstd/tests

This directory contains all test code, test data, and test outputs for the 7-Zip-zstd integration work.

## Layout

- data/: input archives and fixtures for smoke tests.
- logs/: test run logs.
- run-smoke.sh: basic validation script.

## Scope

- Keep all new tests for this integration under deps/7-Zip-zstd/tests.
- Do not write test artifacts outside deps/7-Zip-zstd/tests and deps/7-Zip-zstd/logs.
